concerns.text: FR-001 states that `p_value_delta`, `direction`, `ci_overlap`, and `effect_size_change` are stored in `baseline_metrics.json`. These delta metrics inherently compare baseline to cleaned variants, so they logically belong in the cleaned‑variant output (e.g., `cleaned_metrics.json`). Storing them in the baseline file creates a contradictory data model with FR-006 and SC-001, which expect delta reporting per cleaned variant.
